title: Tilli Software Shines at Global Fintech Fest 2023: Fostering Innovation and Collaboration
summary: Showcased Nudge, Monay, B2B Payouts, and BBPS Onboarding while deepening partnerships at GFF 2023.
locationIntro: Hyderabad – September 14, 2023 — Tilli Software India Pvt. Ltd., a leading fintech solutions provider, proudly announced its successful participation in Global Fintech Fest 2023, where it showcased its suite of innovative fintech products—including Nudge, Monay, B2B Payout Solution, and BBPS Biller Onboarding Services.
body:
Building on relationships formed during the 2022 event, Tilli Software nurtured deeper collaborations and expanded its role as a Technology Service Provider (TSP) within the NPCI BBPS ecosystem—now a full-fledged partnership for enabling seamless bill payment capabilities.

Ali Saberi, Founder & CEO of Tilli Software, shared:

“We were thrilled by the exceptional interest in our fintech solutions, particularly our B2B Vendor and Supplier Payout Solution and BBPS Biller Onboarding Services. These offerings underscore our dedication to simplifying financial processes and promoting digital inclusion. I had the opportunity to express my gratitude to Ms. Noopur Chaturvedi, CEO of NBBL, for supporting our participation in India’s groundbreaking BBPS ecosystem. Through Tilli’s role as the TSP, we facilitate seamless biller onboarding and contribute to a future where digital financial accessibility becomes a reality for all.”

Throughout the event, Tilli’s team engaged in meaningful dialogues with fintech and banking officials—answering pressing questions and exploring future regulation and compliance landscapes.

The event also saw the Reserve Bank of India and NPCI introduce innovations like Credit Line on UPI, Billpay Connect, and UPI Tap & Pay—trends that Tilli Software is actively considering integrating into its product offerings.

aboutSections.heading: About Tilli Software
aboutSections.text: Based in McLean, Virginia, with a significant presence in Hyderabad, India, Tilli Software delivers global digital payment solutions and cloud-based CPaaS offerings. Its flagship tools include: tilliX – a branded, cloud-enabled API-based platform for seamless digital payments and customer communication; Nudge – an event-driven engagement and bill presentment tool designed for high-conversion payment experiences; tilliPay – an omnichannel payment gateway and wallet supporting P2P, B2B, C2B, and B2C flows; and B2B Payout & BBPS Onboarding Services – secure vendor payouts and efficient biller enrollment via NPCI's BBPS platform.

title: Tilli 2024 Top 100 MBE Award by CRMSDC
summary: CRMSDC names Tilli a 2024 Top 100 Minority Business Enterprise for innovation and impact.
locationIntro: McLean, VA – October 9, 2024 — A leader in customer experience solutions for the recurring billing industry announces its selection as a winner of the prestigious 2024 Top 100 Minority Business Enterprises (MBE) Award by the Capital Region Minority Supplier Development Council and is the only provider of Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment (EBPP) / Digital Customer Communications recognized.
body:
This award honors excellence in business, commitment to customer engagement, and positive industry impact.

The Top 100 MBE Award recognizes outstanding minority-owned businesses demonstrating excellence in innovation, operational success, and community impact. Winners are selected through a rigorous process that evaluates innovation, community contributions, and financial performance—judged by an esteemed panel from diverse industries.

Acceptance remarks by the Founder and CEO highlight appreciation of the recognition and reaffirm dedication to delivering exceptional value to clients and partners.

The award will be presented at CRMSDC’s 39th Annual Leaders & Legends Awards Ceremony on November 19, 2024, at the MGM National Harbor.
aboutCompany:
Based in McLean, VA, the company was founded by a team of seasoned professionals committed to leveraging technology to elevate customer engagement and payment experiences, while optimizing business operations. Their hallmark solutions include:


tilliX – A customer self-service platform delivering seamless cross-device accessibility, personalized communication, real-time usage insights, and customizable UX.

Nudge – A digital customer communication engine featuring dynamic messaging across Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and IVR channels.

Monay – A secure and flexible payment processing solution supporting a variety of channels and payment methods like debit/credit cards, ACH, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal/Venmo, and more.
aboutCrmsdc:
The Capital Region Minority Supplier Development Council is a nonprofit organization that advances business opportunities for minority-owned companies in Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia. Through advocacy, certification, and business development programs, CRMSDC empowers minority entrepreneurs in the region.

The Top 100 MBE Awards celebrate minority businesses that excel and contribute significantly to their communities. The program is coordinated among CRMSDC, the MBDA Business Center Virginia, and the Capital Readiness Program—all dedicated to strengthening minority-owned businesses.

title: Billers Can Boost On-Time Payments and Streamline Operations with Enhanced Billing and Payment Communications from Fiserv
date: Published on: April 30, 2024, at 9:00 AM EDT
summary: Integrated call-to-action communications within BillMatrix®, powered by Tilli’s Nudge, help billers increase on-time payments and efficiency.
locationIntro: Milwaukee – April 30, 2024 — Fiserv is introducing integrated communication capabilities for billers, aimed at improving customer engagement and on-time payment rates while enhancing operational efficiency
body:
Fiserv is enhancing BillMatrix® by integrating call-to-action notifications and alerts into existing billing workflows. Billers can now deliver personalized reminders via email, SMS, outbound calls, or interactive voice response (IVR) systems—helping customers take action at the right moment.

“Today's consumers expect tailored, effortless experiences that span multiple channels... Our platform, Nudge, delivers precisely this potent and personalized communication... Through our collaboration with Fiserv… we are poised to further enhance customer experiences and significantly improve return rates.” — Ali Saberi, Founder & CEO at Tilli.

According to Datos Insights (Q3 2023), 68% of U.S. cell phone users who sometimes miss bill payments due to forgetfulness rated a text reminder as “extremely valuable” or “very valuable.” Further, most recipients of such reminders paid using links in those messages.

Washington Gas, serving the D.C. region, saw notable results by deploying this solution, achieving a 140% boost in eBill enrollments and a 20% increase in digital payments.

aboutSections.text: Fiserv, Inc. is a global leader in payments and financial technology solutions, specializing in products like BillMatrix® to modernize billing and enhance operational efficiency for businesses and billers

aboutSections.heading: About the Integration
aboutSections.text: This initiative combines Fiserv's BillMatrix® billing engine with Tilli’s Nudge communication platform, offering a unified solution that seamlessly integrates notifications into digital workflows to drive engagement and payments

title: Join Tilli at CS Week 2024 to Nudge Your Customers for On-Time Payments and Several Other Call-To-Actions
summary: Meet our leadership at CS Week in Fort Worth (Booth #622) and explore multichannel digital communications that drive on-time payments.
locationIntro: Fort Worth, TX – April 24, 2024 — Tilli, a leading FinTech digital communication company and provider of comprehensive e-bill presentment and customer communication solutions, is announcing the presence of its leadership team—Ali Saberi (Founder & CEO) and Shabbir Gilani (Chief Revenue Officer)—at CS Week 2024, taking place from April 30 to May 2 in Fort Worth, TX.
body:
Attendees are invited to meet the team at Fiserv Booth #622 to explore innovative digital solutions that enhance customer communication and engagement—focusing on optimized utility payments, reduced costs, and modeling consumer behavior across the billing journey.

“We are excited to be a part of CS Week 2024 and we are here to spotlight the significance of digital bill presentment and payments in reducing costs and boosting customer satisfaction and engagement scores.” He added, “We look forward to meeting with a number of organizations looking to improve their e-bill adoption and digital customer communications.”

On May 1, 2024, at 3:15 PM, Ali Saberi will join a panel discussion titled “Digital Transformation for Enhanced Customer Engagement and Optimized Payments” with strategic partners from Fiserv and Washington Gas.

The session will highlight the effectiveness of a multichannel digital strategy and bill payment workflows—including web, email, SMS, IVR, and proactive use cases like new bill prompts, reminders, outage alerts, appointment confirmations, customer agreements, and field payments.

These deployments have delivered measurable improvements in on-time payments, reduced DSO (daily sales outstanding), lower paper and call-center volume, and significantly improved customer engagement for Washington Gas.

title: Tilli Software Joins Washington Gas in “Party with a Purpose” to Support Community Initiatives
summary: Tilli joined Washington Gas’s “Party with a Purpose” supporting WAFF; celebrating a decade-long partnership and community impact.
locationIntro: McLean, Virginia – September 29, 2023 — Tilli Software, a leading fintech solutions and technology service provider, participated in a fundraiser event hosted by Washington Gas Limited (WGL), titled “Party with a Purpose.” The event was held on September 27 in celebration of Washington Gas’ 175th anniversary and supported the Washington Area Fuel Fund (WAFF).
body:
For over a decade, Tilli Software has partnered with Washington Gas to deliver robust technological and digital solutions that elevate customer experience. Key offerings in this collaboration include TilliCX, an advanced customer experience platform, and Nudge, an omnichannel customer communication platform. Together, they’ve facilitated streamlined digital bill presentment, secure payment collection, and real-time communication with Washington Gas’ customers.

“Celebrating Washington Gas Limited's 175th anniversary was a true honor. Our collaboration with WGL is deeply ingrained in our shared values and in the fabric of our solutions that empower the organization and its valued customers… Our sincere gratitude goes to WGL for providing us the opportunity to contribute to such a vital cause and make a lasting difference in the communities we serve.” — Ali Saberi, Founder & CEO at Tilli Software.

During the pandemic, Tilli Software further supported Washington Gas by developing and processing critical COVID-19 relief attestation forms and managing related payments—demonstrating a strong, service-driven partnership during challenging times.

The event aimed to benefit the Washington Area Fuel Fund (WAFF)—a longstanding Washington Gas initiative (over 40 years)—which supports local families during financial hardship, particularly in winter. Tilli Software supported this cause through a charitable sponsorship donation. Notably, Washington Gas ensures that 100% of partner donations go directly toward providing warmth, safety, and shelter to seniors and children in the DMV (D.C., Maryland, Virginia) area.

Tilli Software looks forward to continuing its collaboration with Washington Gas to support communities through future initiatives.

aboutSections.heading: About Tilli Software
aboutSections.text: Tilli Software is a fintech innovator offering digital engagement and payment solutions. Its product suite includes TilliCX, Nudge, and its newer B2B payout and BBPS onboarding services—all designed to enhance customer interactions, simplify billing workflows, and support seamless payments and integrations.

aboutSections.heading: About Washington Gas & WAFF
aboutSections.text: Washington Gas Limited, a subsidiary of AltaGas Ltd., is a long-established natural gas utility serving over 1.2 million customers in Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia. Celebrating over 175 years of service, the company is deeply rooted in community outreach. The Washington Area Fuel Fund (WAFF) is a flagship initiative of Washington Gas that, for more than four decades, has helped over 300,000 families with heating costs during financial hardship—especially in the winter months.

title: Tilli Software to Showcase Cutting-Edge Fintech Solutions at Global Fintech Fest 2023
summary: Tilli Software will spotlight its cutting-edge fintech products—including the Monay Global Payment System, B2B Payout Solution, Merchant Processing System, and BBPS Biller Onboarding Services (as a Technology Service Provider)—at Booths E19 and E21 during the event.
locationIntro: Hyderabad – August 21, 2023 — Tilli Software India Pvt. Ltd, a leading tech innovator in the fintech industry, is all set to make a remarkable presence at the upcoming Global Fintech Fest 2023, slated to take place from 5th to 7th September 2023 at Jio Convention Center, Mumbai.
body:
As a proud participant in this prestigious event, Tilli Software is excited to present a suite of groundbreaking products that promise to revolutionize the fintech landscape.

Visitors of the event can embrace innovation and discover a host of fintech advancements at Tilli Software’s booth E19 and E21. The spotlight will be on some cutting-edge solutions such as Monay Global Payment System, B2B Payout Solution, Merchant Processing System, and BBPS Biller Onboarding Services with Tilli as a Technology Service Provider (TSP).

Last year, Tilli Software’s participation in GFF 2022 as a “Silver Sponsor” was marked by a pivotal step towards association with NPCI’s BBPS program. As a leading Technology Service Provider (TSP), Tilli introduced an adapter-based framework, revolutionizing the integration process for Billers with any ERP or system of record onto the BBPS platform. Leveraging this cutting-edge solution, Tilli continues to offer unrivalled onboarding capabilities, reducing the onboarding time to an impressive 2 weeks in contrast to the conventional 6 to 8 weeks.

Setting the stage for a triumphant return to Global Fintech Fest, Tilli Software’s Founder and CEO, Mr. Ali Saberi, reflects on the journey since last year’s event and states that, “GFF 2022 gave us a flying start by opening our doors for NPCI’s BBPS program. Carrying the baton of last year and nurturing our relationship with NPCI’s BBPS, we are pumped up with more energy to take the next leap by launching our new fintech products and services at GFF 2023, including, B2B Payout Solution, BBPS Biller Onboarding Services as a Technology Service provider (TSP), and Monay Global Payment System. Team Tilli eagerly awaits the arrival of our esteemed partners and cherished customers at our booth to experience our transformative products.”

Join us at Global Fintech Fest 2023, and together, let’s shape the future of fintech with innovation, efficiency, and excellence.

title: Tilli Software India Pvt. Ltd. Attends TiE Global Summit, 2022
summary: Showcased Nudge and Monay at TiE Global Summit 2022, highlighting customer-centric digital payments and omnichannel communications.
locationIntro: Hyderabad — December 12–14, 2022 — Hyderabad-based FinTech start-up, headquartered in the US, exhibited as a promising FinTech at the TiE Global Summit 2022, organized at the Hyderabad International Convention Center.
body:
Tilli Software successfully garnered the attention and took the limelight in the event with its unique product duo, Nudge and Monay. These solutions offer a unique digital payment processing experience clubbed with an omni-channel cloud communication system for a wholesome customer experience. The innovative product simplifies bill presentment and payment experience by harnessing the reactive behavior of the consumer while simplifying merchant payment processing, preference management, and personalization across its multi-channel customer communication. This story has also been notably covered in a popular Telugu newspaper “Andhra Jyoti”.

Conversing with the media, Mr. Ali Saberi, Founder & CEO Tilli Software stated that,

“the energy among the start-ups here is worth recognition. I find this a nurturing environment and love the ability to easily network with peers, mentors, and potential investors within a few days within the same premises; an opportunity of a lifetime. I believed in my own karma and kept away from TIE for a long time, however, now I see the value of this thriving ecosystem (dharma) that encourages innovation and supports growth for promising young entrepreneurs. Kudos to the TIE organization”

The CTO, Mr. Raja Vemuri added to the discussion and stated that,

“customer-centricity is the need of the hour and our products imbibe this feature by seeking customer consent and empowering them with their choice of communication channel. We also ensure safe, quick and omnichannel payment experience through Monay which is a robust and secured PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant platform that ensures complete data privacy.”

Tilli Software is in the process of being a registered pane-list in NPCI BBPS list of Technology Service Providers (TSP). The services offered by the company are suitable for diverse industry verticals like Utilities, Banking & Finance, Insurance, Lending, Health & Medical, Education, and many others.

title: Monay, Powered by Nudge Marked its Promising Presence at the Global FinTech Fest, Mumbai, India.
summary: Tilli showcased Monay and Nudge at GFF 2022; strong response and participation in key sessions.
locationIntro: Monay, Powered by Nudge, Successfully Introduces its GPS & CPaaS System at the GFF 2022 – Press Release.
body:
Nudge marked its promising presence at the Global FinTech Fest, 2022. Inaugurated by Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman, Indian minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs, the three-day event was all about financial inclusion, payments, ONDC, FinTech chatbots, and more.

The Hyderabad-based digital payment and customer communication platform provider Tilli Software India Pvt. Ltd, also a “Silver Sponsor” at GFF 2022, successfully introduced the one-of-its-kind digital payment and digital wallet system Monay, coupled with cloud-based omni-channel customer communication platform Nudge, at the Global FinTech Fest, 2022 in Mumbai.

While the two products received a warm welcome and an overwhelming response from renowned FinTech fraternities on the spot, the company also participated in several sessions organized by NPCI that reiterated the commitment to sustainable FinTech developments in India.

Inaugurated by Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman, Indian minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs, the three-day event organized multiple sessions running around the theme of sustainability, financial inclusion, payments, ONDC, FinTech chatbots, and more.

The CEO, Mr. Ali Saberi, and other crucial members of the leadership team attended exclusive events at the venue including the CXO meeting honored by the presence of Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. The team also participated in an exclusive invite to the Bharat BillPay Innovation Launch which provided a very workable networking platform with innovation, strategy, and business.

Mr. Saberi was also a member of the in-panel discussion on “Raising the bar — Delivering Extraordinary Customer Experience,” in which he shared real-world insights gained over his years of hands-on experience in building world-class customer experiences. His discussion on bringing "The ‘aha moment’ in customer communication through timely, contextual, and personalized messaging" stood out.

He also discussed making meaningful and mindful communication through bots for enhanced customer engagement, achieved via use-case-driven programming of bots with robust AI. This not only adds value to customer experience but also reduces call-center operational costs.

The event culminated with three major announcements, where RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das rolled out UPI Lite, RuPay Credit Card on UPI, and Bharat BillPay Cross-Border Bill Payments.

The Tilli Software team experienced an engaging and insightful event—connecting with peers and industry leaders, exploring partnerships, and driving innovation toward a secure, inclusive, and convenient fintech future, delivering next-level customer experiences.

aboutSections.heading: About Tilli Software
aboutSections.text: Tilli Software is a FinTech startup based in Hyderabad and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, USA. The company offers its newly launched flagship products Monay and Nudge. Monay is a modern payment experience cloud that serves digitally forward businesses globally with secure online payment processing and the trusted communication suite offered by Nudge. It helps enterprises tap into the digital economy with out-of-the-box, secure, cloud-based payment solutions. This omni-channel payment gateway empowers both customers and service providers with tools to deeply engage throughout the user journey.

The event culminated with three big announcements, wherein the Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das rolled out UPI Lite, RuPay Credit Card on UPI, and Bharat BillPay Cross-Border Bill Payments.

The team “Tilli Software” had a very engaging experience at the event connecting with peers and industry leaders, navigating ways for partnerships and innovation to contribute towards a fintech world that is secure, inclusive and highly convenient, delivering next-level of customer experience to the people.

title: Monay, powered by Nudge, to be a part of Global FinTech Fest as a Silver Sponsor
summary: Tilli participates as a Silver Sponsor at Global FinTech Fest; meet us at Booths E11 and E13.
locationIntro: Tilli Software India Pvt Ltd, a digital payment experience cloud with a CPaaS solution, is excited to announce its participation as one of the Silver Sponsors at the third annual Global FinTech Fest at the Jio Convention Center in Mumbai from 19 to 22 September.
body:
This global event shares space with over 30,000 of the world’s brightest minds to explore the role Finance Technology plays in our collective future and in designing a safe and sustainable financial world.

Event attendees can locate Tilli at Booths E11 and E13 to connect with the experts, build networks, or discover more about the company and its product Monay, powered by Nudge, a first-of-its-kind combination of digital payments integrated with an Omni-channel CPaaS.

This global platform is filled with opportunities for major players in the FinTech space, something the Monay team is thrilled about.

Mr. Ali Saberi, CEO of Tilli, was openly excited about the event.

“I am excited to introduce our innovative fintech solutions as critical enablers of India Stack’s vision of ‘identity, payments, and data at population scale,” Mr. Saberi raved.
“Our Nudge CPaaS platform provides a digital voice to businesses of all sizes, allowing them to communicate with their customers through personalized omnichannel digital messages efficiently. Our branded call-to-actions — #CTA — are embedded into the Nudge platform for secure payment requests, deferrals, or instalments.”

Mr. Saberi added,

“Nudge’s platform is integrated in real-time with Monay, our global payment gateway, and other backend ERP systems that power today’s economies. By putting the business in the driver’s seat, Nudge and Monay reduce the dependency and hardship associated with technology, allowing companies to spend more time on customer segmentation, message personalization, and financial reconciliation. This effectively decreases accounts receivable aging and increases operational savings, as witnessed by our existing customers. With multi-language communications, call-to-action pages and preference management built into Nudge.PRO, we offer the best payment experience in the industry.”

Participants and visitors of the fest can hear more from Mr. Saberi at the in-panel discussion on “Raising the Bar: Delivering Extraordinary Customer Experience” on 20 September from 10:40 am to 11:30 am. Secure your place at the talk today to uncover how to create an exceptional customer experience that can boost your organizations’ bottom line.

This budding company is ready with yet another engaging event during the fest by organizing a “Lucky Draw” to hunt for the three lucky iPad winners. Beginning on 20 September, on every day of the event, one winner will be chosen and announced at the “Monay powered by Nudge” booth. Anyone visiting the event can sign up online or at booths E11 and E13 to nominate themselves for the lucky draw.

With so much in store, the power-packed duo of Monay and Nudge would surely make strides in redefining the digital payment and customer communication experience of the people with greater ease, reliability, and speed.
